mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,parent_id,root_id FROM proj_project WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.projectId} AND deleted=FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT tree_version FROM proj_project_tree_version WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND root_project_id=#{query.projectId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND deleted=FALSE ORDER BY tree_version DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,tenant_id,parent_id,root_id FROM proj_project WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND root_id=#{query.projectId} AND deleted=FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE proj_project_tree_version SET status='ACTIVE',node_count=1,path_count=1,activated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, failed_reason=NULL,updater=#{row.actor},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{row.id} AND tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND root_project_id=#{row.rootProjectId} AND tree_version=1 AND status='BUILDING' AND deleted=FALSE
